patch.value: Node-CLI acceptance test assumes pmc-or-pm item prefixes and leaks the invoking PM tracker

The real node-CLI extension acceptance passes in the package checkout but fails when invoked through companion pm test because inherited PM_PROJECT_PATH creates valid pm-cli-website item references while the assertion hardcodes pmc-or-pm IDs. The fixture must own its tracker and prove a long configured prefix without weakening the rendered link contract.

The acceptance fixture explicitly isolates project and global PM paths; it initializes a pm-cli-website prefix; it asserts the exact created item ID and matching .toon URL without a permissive hardcoded prefix regex; direct package and companion-linked release gates pass at exact 100/100/100
pm-changelog 2026.8.7 with @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.7; companion pm test sandbox
Run the release gate with PM_PROJECT_PATH pointing at a tracker whose id_prefix is pm-cli-website; generator.test.ts node-CLI acceptance rejects the valid item link.
The real installed pm CLI acceptance is deterministic under arbitrary invoking PM environments and validates the item reference emitted for the item it created.
Under companion linked-test context the generator correctly emits pm-cli-website IDs but the test expects only pm or pmc and fails after 405 passing tests.
Cross-project and agent harness verification reports a false release failure even though generated changelog output is correct.

patch.value: The acceptance now owns PM_PATH and PM_GLOBAL_PATH, initializes pm-cli-website, creates pm-cli-website-prefix-proof, and asserts its exact rendered .toon link. The focused installed-CLI test passes; direct release check and PM_PATH=.agents/pm coverage both pass with 406 tests and exact 100/100/100.
Made the acceptance fixture independent of the invoking tracker and replaced the pmc-or-pm regex with the exact deterministic long-prefix item link.

value.text: Regression evidence: companion-linked execution produced valid pm-cli-website IDs and the old hardcoded regex failed after 405 passes. Corrected fixture passes against the real package-local @unbrained/pm-cli 2026.8.7. Direct npm release check is green with zero production vulnerabilities; package-owned PM_PATH coverage is 406 of 406 and exact 100/100/100. An intentionally foreign PM_PATH can still change unrelated CLI coverage paths and makes the prepare lifecycle correctly reject an out-of-repository tracker; that is not treated as a supported release environment.
